verdict.rationale: Official GitHub README states Godot supports one-click export to desktop (Linux/macOS/Windows), mobile (Android/iOS), web, and consoles, directly matching the studio-lead's cross-platform export need; console export is well-known to go through certified third-party middleware/partners in Godot's ecosystem. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of the console partner/porting process and independent community confirmation of a shipped console title, since community evidence only discusses desktop/web/mobile experiences.
